sample_unit: AI-generated post-operative instruction sets (4 procedures x 2 platforms)

links.outcome: Readability, understandability and actionability of AI-generated post-operative instructions (PEMAT)
links.effect: Instructions from ChatGPT and Gemini were understandable but poor for actionability and readability; numeric scores not reported in the abstract.
links.quote: ChatGPT and Gemini were capable of generating understandable post-operative instructions but were poor for actionability and readability.

screen.reason: Evaluates readability, understandability, and actionability of patient post-operative instructions generated by ChatGPT and Gemini for rhinologic surgeries.
